headline: Enhance CodeClip with AI Integration
summary: Integrate AI-driven code suggestions and error detection to improve the user experience. Implement a chatbot for basic support and feedback collection. Use machine learning models to categorize and suggest relevant snippets based on user history.
actions: Implement an AI-powered code suggestion feature that suggests related or similar code snippets as users type, enhancing productivity.
Develop a chatbot using natural language processing (NLP) for basic support queries and feedback collection, improving user engagement.
Utilize machine learning algorithms to categorize and suggest relevant code snippets based on the user's previous interactions and search history.
